description: Read Workday HR data (org chart, worker profiles, tasks, pay, benefits, compensation, your app menu) from a shell with the fpx CLI (@fetchproxy/cli) instead of running the workday-mcp server — fetch any *.htmld data endpoint through your own signed-in *.myworkday.com tab (SSO/Ping/Okta/Entra already cleared). Use when you want Workday data without the MCP, in a script, or on a machine where the MCP isn't installed.
